boss_intro: Welcome, small knight. I am the Wall of the Bay. Walls are in no hurry.
Approach with patience, little rex. Haste breaks upon me like the tide.
taunt_mid: A fine swing. The wall remains.
Patience is also a weapon. Observe me wield it.
You strike with spirit. Try striking with timing.
hit_react: Well struck. I shall allow it.
A worthy blow. There will not be many.
low_hp: You have found the loose stone in me, haven't you.
defeat_freed: The cog falls away… and the wall bows. Honourably done, little architect.
Freed — and by fair engineering. My shield is yours, whenever you need it.
